text:
Silver Price in 1976
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1976, the LBMA silver price rose 8.6% between 1976-01-30 ($4.01) and 1976-12-31 ($4.36). The highest sampled price was $4.83 in June and the lowest was $4.01 in January. The mean of these observations was $4.34. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
